items.title: A Prompt-Injection Firewall for AI Agents and RAG Pipelines
items.raw_excerpt:
We built SafeBrowse — an open-source prompt-injection firewall for AI systems. Instead of relying on better prompts, SafeBrowse enforces a hard security boundary between untrusted web content and LLMs. It blocks hidden instructions, policy violations, and poisoned data before the AI ever sees it. Features:
• Prompt injection detection (50+ patterns)
• Policy engine (login/payment blocking)
• Fail-closed by design
• Audit logs & request IDs • Python SDK (sync + async)
• RAG sanitization PyPI: pip install safebrowse Looking for feedback from AI infra, security, and agent builders.

title_i18n.en: A Prompt-Injection Firewall for AI Agents and RAG Pipelines
title_i18n.zh: AI代理与RAG管道的即时注入防火墙
title_i18n.es: Un Cortafuegos de Inyección de Prompts para Agentes de IA y Tuberías RAG

excerpt_i18n.en:
We built SafeBrowse — an open-source prompt-injection firewall for AI systems. Instead of relying on better prompts, SafeBrowse enforces a hard security boundary between untrusted web content and LLMs. It blocks hidden instructions, policy violations, and poisoned data before the AI ever sees it. Features:
• Prompt injection detection (50+ patterns)
• Policy engine (login/payment blocking)
• Fail-closed by design
• Audit logs & request IDs • Python SDK (sync + async)
• RAG sanitization PyPI: pip install safebrowse Looking for feedback from AI infra, security, and agent builders.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们开发了SafeBrowse——一个为AI系统设计的开源提示注入防火墙。不同于依赖优化提示，SafeBrowse在不可信网络内容与大型语言模型之间建立了严格的安全边界，能有效拦截隐藏的指令注入攻击。
excerpt_i18n.es: Desarrollamos SafeBrowse — un cortafuegos de inyección de prompts de código abierto para sistemas de IA. En lugar de depender de mejores prompts, SafeBrowse impone un límite de seguridad estricto entre el contenido web no verificado y los LLM. Bloquea las instrucciones ocultas

items.title: Emotional Intelligence: Moving AI from Emotion Detection to True Understanding
items.raw_excerpt:
We've discovered how to give AI true emotional intelligence through a 4-layer framework. *The Current State:*
Most AI can detect emotions ("I see you're frustrated") but can't understand WHY, WHAT'S AT STAKE, or HOW emotions evolve. *The Breakthrough:*
A 4-layer Emotional Intelligence Framework: *Layer 1: Deep Contextual Modeling*
Context graph with agents, events, social dynamics, stakes, narrative arc. AI understands not just WHAT you feel, but WHY and WHAT'S AT STAKE. *Layer 2: Computational Appraisal Theory*
Goal relevance, goal congruence, coping potential, normative significance, agency. AI simulates how emotions arise from situations (like humans do). *Layer 3: Embodied Resonance Modeling*
Perspective-taking, vulnerability mapping, emotional trajectory prediction. AI can feel WITH y

items.title: PermaMind AI agents with persistent identity (open source)
items.raw_excerpt:
I built an architecture where AI agents don't reset their internal state between sessions. Most systems reload the base model every time. PermaMind adds a writable identity layer that evolves based on experience: - Gap Engine: Detects prediction errors (Δ) and prioritizes learning
- Confidence Gate: Blocks assertions when unresolved failures exist
- Identity Store: Persists constraints across sessions Demo showing save/refresh/load persistence: https://bapxai.com/pssu.html Published the framework in November 2024. Fully open source (MIT). Looking for feedback on the architecture and potential use cases.

title_i18n.en: PermaMind AI agents with persistent identity (open source)
title_i18n.zh: 具有持久身份的PermaMind AI代理（开源）
title_i18n.es: Agentes de inteligencia artificial PermaMind con identidad persistente (de código abierto)

excerpt_i18n.en:
I built an architecture where AI agents don't reset their internal state between sessions. Most systems reload the base model every time. PermaMind adds a writable identity layer that evolves based on experience: - Gap Engine: Detects prediction errors (Δ) and prioritizes learning
- Confidence Gate: Blocks assertions when unresolved failures exist
- Identity Store: Persists constraints across sessions Demo showing save/refresh/load persistence: https://bapxai.com/pssu.html Published the framework in November 2024. Fully open source (MIT). Looking for feedback on the architecture and potential use cases.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我构建了一种架构，其中AI智能体在会话之间不会重置其内部状态。大多数系统每次都会重新加载基础模型。PermaMind则增加了一个可写的身份层，该层会根据经验不断演进：- Gap E
excerpt_i18n.es: Construí una arquitectura donde los agentes de IA no reinician su estado interno entre sesiones. La mayoría de los sistemas recargan el modelo base cada vez. PermaMind añade una capa de identidad modificable que evoluciona según la experiencia: - Gap E

items.title: Why autonomous AI agents fail in production
items.raw_excerpt:
Most AI agent demos look impressive. They plan tasks, call tools, self-correct, and complete workflows end-to-end.
But when teams try to deploy them in production — especially where money, safety, or compliance is involved — the same problems appear again and again. Not because the models are inaccurate, but because the system is structurally unsafe. Here are the failure modes I keep seeing: Non-replayable decisions
Agent behavior depends on implicit context, dynamic reasoning, and probabilistic paths.
When something goes wrong, you can’t reliably replay why a decision was made. Probabilistic components with execution authority
Language models generate plausible outputs, not deterministic decisions.
Giving them final execution power creates an unbounded risk surface. No hard veto layer
Man
